description: This file defines the class 'du_pucch_resource_manager' responsible for managing RAN PUCCH resources in a 5G DU context, including resource allocation, deallocation, and configuration management for UEs and cells.

classes.name: du_pucch_resource_manager
classes.description: Manages allocation and configuration of PUCCH resources for DU UEs, ensuring no collisions and respecting resource limits.

methods.name: add_cell
methods.description: Adds resources for a new DU cell.

methods.name: rem_cell
methods.description: Removes all resources for a specified DU cell.

methods.name: alloc_resources
methods.description: Allocates PUCCH resources for a UE based on cell group configuration.

methods.name: dealloc_resources
methods.description: Deallocates previously assigned PUCCH resources from a UE.

methods.name: get_nof_free_sr_configs
methods.description: Returns the number of free SR configurations for a given cell.

methods.name: get_nof_free_csi_configs
methods.description: Returns the number of free CSI configurations for a given cell.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a cell is configured.
